title: TestRequest
description: Which checkout to test, which test files to run there, and how long the run may take.

folder.description: The folder that holds a checkout of the code: inside the project, and given relative to it or in full.

items.description: A test file, relative to the checkout; it cannot leave the checkout or start with a dash.

files.description: The test files to run; left out, every test runs.

timeLimitSeconds.description: How long the run may take before it is stopped and its verdict is inconclusive; left out, the toolchain's own limit applies.
